description: List issued invoices from Quipu, with number, issue_date, due_date, total, subtotal and payment status. Paginated via `page`. Use `filter_from` and `filter_to` to bound the period — this is the tool to use when asked about revenue or VAT for a quarter, since Quipu has no endpoint that returns tax models directly and the figures must be derived from invoices.

filter_from.description: Only invoices issued on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

filter_to.description: Only invoices issued on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: list_invoices
